mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Yield curve inverts (10y-2y < 0) during the signal period, indicating a looming recession that will negate the positive earnings impulse.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the year-over-year change in the industrial production index, signals a supply shock that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances following a sharp INDPRO drop, indicating the market is discounting a quick recovery.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the unemployment rate, defined as an increase of more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous 3 months, signals a weakening labor market that will negatively impact consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Retail sales (RSAFS) continue to grow at an above-trend rate despite the UNRATE spike, indicating consumer resilience that will support equity prices.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, indicating the market is discounting a 'soft landing' scenario.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) both decline by more than 5% year-over-year, it signals a broad-based demand slowdown that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Either HOUST or RSAFS rebounds to positive y/y growth within 3 months, indicating the demand slowdown is transitory.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing PMI falls below 45, indicating a contraction in the manufacturing sector, and the CPI inflation rate is above 3%, signaling supply-driven inflationary pressures, the combination will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 10-year Treasury yield falls by more than 50 basis points over the signal period, indicating the market expects the Fed to cut rates in response to the growth slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) is growing by more than 200,000 jobs per month, the tight labor market conditions will drive wage inflation and negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Average hourly earnings growth slows to below 3% y/y, indicating wage pressures are easing despite the tight labor market.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is rising and the yield curve (10y-2y spread) is inverted, the combination of tightening monetary policy and inverted yield curve will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The yield curve steepens by more than 50 basis points during the signal period, indicating the market expects a monetary policy pivot.
